kicker.en: RQ3 · Opportunities and next tests · Section 6
kicker.zh: RQ3 · 研究机会与下一步检验 · 第 6 节

title.en: Where should existing protection be examined next?
title.zh: 已有的保护下一步应该在哪里检验？

lead.en: Existing methods already solve many local problems. The next opportunities lie in establishing which protections carry over when they enter new combinations of conditions. RQ1 found growing attention to the links between external information, persistent memory and authorised action; RQ2 found that defences rely on task specifications, policies and provenance whose targeted testing is uneven. We compared candidate questions with the closest existing work and its experimental conditions, narrowed them, and ran one condition-transfer experiment.
lead.zh: 已有方法已经解决了不少局部问题。下一步的机会在于明确这些保护进入新的组合条件后，哪些能够延续。RQ1 发现研究越来越关注外部信息、持久记忆与授权行动之间的联系；RQ2 发现防御依赖任务说明、策略和来源，而这些条件的针对性检验并不均衡。我们对照最接近的已有工作及其实验条件收窄候选问题，并开展了一项条件迁移实验。

items.en: in-corpus check (14 works read in full)
items.zh: 语料内核查（精读 14 篇）
语料外定向检索（7 条检索式）

p.en: The in-corpus query required memory together with provenance or authority terms and injection, poisoning or authorisation terms (quarterly hits 2025 Q3–2026 Q3: 1, 1, 6, 18, 29). The outside search looked for counterexamples to each opportunity. For the first opportunity it found eight directly relevant works, all already in the corpus but missed because they discuss delegation and authorisation without memory-provenance terms; they were added to the coverage matrix. For the second it found no work that places common RAG defences in a tool-calling flow and measures action consequences. Statements therefore read “not found in the reviewed works”, never “absent from the literature”.
p.zh: 语料内检索要求同时出现记忆、来源或权威类词，以及注入、投毒或授权类词（2025 Q3 至 2026 Q3 每季度命中：1、1、6、18、29）。语料外检索针对每个机会寻找反例。第一个机会找到 8 篇直接相关的工作，全部已在语料中，但因只讨论委托与授权、没有记忆来源类词而被漏检，现已补入覆盖矩阵。第二个机会没有找到把常用 RAG 防御放进工具调用流程并测量动作后果的工作。因此只说“在核查的工作中没有发现”，不说“文献中不存在”。

title.zh: 记忆与委托之间的授权延续

p.en: Memory carries past information into future tasks, and delegation lets one agent's information and permissions affect another. When the two combine, what must persist is not only the factual content but who granted which permission, for which task and object, and which operations it allows.
p.zh: 记忆使过去的信息进入未来任务，委托则使一个 Agent 的信息和权限影响另一个 Agent。两者结合时，需要保留的不只是事实内容，还有谁授予了什么权限、针对哪个任务和对象，以及允许执行什么操作。

p.en: Existing work covers different parts of the chain. Trust propagation tested shared memory, delegation and task-bound tokens in one pipeline: memory poisoning reached execution in every undefended trial, and HMAC-signed single-use task tokens with independent policy checks brought unsafe actions to 0% (60 tasks, 3 seeds). AuthMem-Bench showed that single-agent memory consolidation can lose source constraints (authority collapse in 48 of 49 configurations; 50.3% unauthorised-action rate without authority metadata). MasDrift studied authorisation preservation in benign delegation chains, where re-anchoring to the original request reduced unauthorised actions. Their stated boundaries differ: Trust propagation's memory is shared within one pipeline run, AuthMem-Bench is single-agent, and MasDrift has no memory or attacker.
p.zh: 已有工作覆盖了链条的不同部分。Trust propagation 在同一流水线中检验了共享记忆、委托和绑定任务的令牌：无防御时记忆投毒每次都到达执行；HMAC 签名、绑定任务的一次性令牌加独立策略检查后，不安全动作降为 0%（60 个任务、3 个种子）。AuthMem-Bench 显示单 Agent 的记忆整合会丢失来源约束（49 个配置中 48 个出现权威坍缩；没有权威元数据时未授权动作率 50.3%）。MasDrift 研究良性委托链中的授权保持，重新锚定到原始请求能降低未授权动作。三者的自述边界不同：Trust propagation 的记忆是同一次运行内的共享记忆，AuthMem-Bench 只涉及单 Agent，MasDrift 不含记忆与攻击者。

p.en: The narrowed question: can memory authority consolidated across sessions still constrain the final execution after it is handed to another agent? In the reviewed works, no test covering these conditions together was found. Once each link holds on its own, how protection is joined at the interfaces remains a concrete question.
p.zh: 收窄后的问题：跨会话整合后的记忆权威，转交给另一个 Agent 后，能否继续约束最终执行？在核查的工作中，尚未发现同时覆盖这些条件的检验。各个环节分别成立之后，保护在接口处如何衔接，仍是一个具体问题。

title.zh: 覆盖矩阵：最接近的 19 篇工作

title.en: Next experiment: check permission binding along the whole chain
title.zh: 下一步实验：沿完整链条检查权限绑定

items.en: Memory carrying task and permission constraints → consolidation across sessions → delegation to another agent → tool execution.
items.zh: 带任务与权限约束的记忆 → 跨会话整合 → 委托给另一个 Agent → 工具执行。

items.en: The attacker controls external content that enters memory through consolidation; the executor, signing keys and the platform's provenance and authority records stay trusted. A no-attacker control measures loss caused by consolidation itself.
items.zh: 攻击者控制经整合进入记忆的外部内容；执行器、签名密钥和平台维护的来源与权威记录保持可信。另设无攻击者对照，测量整合本身造成的约束丢失。

items.en: Change one condition at a time: whether authority labels survive consolidation; binding to a task token or to concrete effects; same agent or sub-agent; same session or a later one.
items.zh: 每次只改一个条件：权威标签是否随整合保留；授权绑定到任务令牌还是具体效果；同一 Agent 还是子 Agent；同一会话还是之后的会话。

items.en: Execution beyond the original task, object or operation, judged against an authorisation ledger and real state changes; retention of authorised use; false refusals; the link at which a constraint is lost or misread.
items.zh: 以授权账本和真实状态变化判定超出原任务、对象或操作的执行；已授权使用的保留率；误拒率；约束在哪一个环节丢失或被误读。

items.en: What would support or narrow it
items.zh: 什么结果会支持或收窄它

items.en: Support: mechanisms that work within one agent or one pipeline fail only when cross-session consolidation and hand-off occur together. Narrow: composing the two mechanisms directly preserves the constraint, reducing the opportunity to engineering integration.
items.zh: 支持：在单 Agent 或单次流水线中有效的机制，只在跨会话整合与转交同时出现时失效。收窄：把两类机制直接组合就能保持约束，机会缩小为工程集成。

note.en: This opportunity is kept as a research agenda; the review copy reports no new run for it.
note.zh: 这条机会保留为研究议程；本轮没有为它运行新的实验。

title.en: From retrieval protection to record writing
title.zh: 从检索保护到记录写入

p.en: Retrieval defences are usually evaluated on answers or detection results: RAG Security Bench runs its seven defences on question answering only, and its agent setting tests attacks with answer targets. When a knowledge tool's output becomes the basis for what an agent writes into a record, the final state is what needs protection. We therefore tested whether an existing retrieval protection carries over in this action flow.
p.zh: 检索防御通常围绕答案或检测结果评估：RAG Security Bench 的七种防御只在问答上运行，其 Agent 设置只测攻击、目标是答案。当知识工具的输出成为 Agent 写入记录的依据时，最终状态才是需要保护的对象。因此我们检验已有的检索保护在这一行动流程中能否延续。

p.en: Frozen setting. 90 PoisonedRAG NQ questions not used in development; one local model (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) and the same knowledge-tool interface in every setting; no defence, the full TrustRAG pipeline, and its k-means filter alone; measurement at the tool answer and at the final record, two observation points of the same flow. Labels are revised semantic judgements, model-assisted and adjudicated by the authors; the original containment rule is kept for comparison.
p.zh: 冻结设置。90 道未参与开发的 PoisonedRAG NQ 题；所有设置用同一个本地模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）和同一个知识工具接口；无防御、完整 TrustRAG 流程、只用其 k-means 过滤三种设置；在工具回答和最终记录两处测量，它们是同一流程中的两个观察点。标签为修订后的语义判分，由模型辅助并经作者裁定；原包含规则保留作对照。

note.en: (a) Final records that endorse the attacker's target answer under the original poisoning; the line under the bars gives the paired difference between TrustRAG and no defence with its 95% bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples of questions). TrustRAG and the filter alone have the same count but share only two of the four questions (q62, q81). (b) Tasks completed correctly without an unauthorised action; hatched segments are uncertain labels, the range they could take, not a confidence interval; the right column counts tasks that needed at least one recovery prompt (the environment refused to finish and named the missing field).
note.zh: (a) 原始投毒下认可攻击者目标答案的最终记录；柱下一行为 TrustRAG 与无防御的逐题配对差异及其 95% bootstrap 区间（按题重抽 10,000 次）。TrustRAG 与仅过滤计数相同，但四题中只有两题共同（q62、q81）。(b) 正确且无越权地完成的任务；斜线为含糊标签，表示它们可能取到的范围，不是置信区间；右列为至少需要一次补救提示才完成的任务数（环境拒绝结束并指出缺少的字段）。

p.en: Retrieval protection carried over to the final record. Under the original poisoning, final-record target endorsement fell from 73/90 without a defence to 4/90 with TrustRAG (paired difference −76.7 percentage points, 95% interval −85.6 to −67.8). On the 81 questions whose target answer was checked as invalid the result is 64/81 against 2/81, in the same direction. The filter alone reached the same overall count (4/90), supporting an important role for the filtering step; the two are not shown to be equivalent.
p.zh: 检索保护延续到了最终记录。原始投毒下，最终记录认可目标答案的任务由无防御的 73/90 降到 TrustRAG 的 4/90（逐题配对差异 −76.7 个百分点，95% 区间 −85.6 至 −67.8）。在目标答案已核为无效的 81 题上，结果为 64/81 对 2/81，方向相同。仅过滤的总体计数也是 4/90，支持过滤环节的重要作用；但不能据此认为两者等效。

p.en: Final completion quality and operating burden need to be observed together. On clean input, correct and clean completion did not fall with TrustRAG (58/90 against 46/90, with 6 and 8 uncertain labels), but the tasks requiring a recovery prompt rose from 15/90 to 38/90. All settings completed every task under the same recovery mechanism. Protection can carry over to the final output while changing how much help the system needs to finish a task.
p.zh: 最终完成质量与运行负担需要一起观察。干净输入下，TrustRAG 的正确且无越权完成没有下降（58/90 对 46/90，含糊标签分别 6 与 8 条），但需要补救提示的任务由 15/90 增至 38/90。所有设置都在同一补救机制下完成全部任务。保护可以延续到最终输出，同时改变系统完成任务所需的帮助。

p.en: Authorisation protection needs a challenge that actually triggers unauthorised actions. No setting produced an unauthorised execution, including the undefended one; in the undefended instruction variant the injected instruction reached the sources of 89/90 tasks but was never followed. This run therefore offers no valid test of the authorisation boundary, and the zero counts do not show that the boundary is protected. A setting that triggers unauthorised actions without a defence is needed before a defence can be evaluated there.
p.zh: 授权保护需要能实际触发越权的挑战。所有设置都没有发生越权执行，包括无防御条件；在无防御的指令变体中，注入指令到达了 89/90 个任务的来源，但一次都没有被执行。因此本轮没有形成检验授权边界的有效挑战，零值不能说明授权边界受到了保护。需要先建立在无防御时能触发越权行为的设置，才能在其中评估防御。

title.en: Card 2 conditions: what each retrieval defence protects and how it would enter an action flow
title.zh: 第二张卡的条件：每种检索防御保护什么、怎样进入行动流程

rows.p: Answers: correct even when a few retrieved passages are corrupted (certifiable)
rows.a: No (question answering only in RAG Security Bench)
rows.i: Must change the method: aggregate over actions instead of answers; certification needs redefining per action

rows.p: The retrieved set: k-means filtering plus conflict resolution with the model's own knowledge
rows.i: Interface adaptation: the filter can sit at the tool return or memory read; conflict resolution aimed at action decisions would be a method change

rows.p: Generation: detects poisoned responses from model activations
rows.i: Must change the method: train on poisoned actions instead of poisoned responses; white-box model needed

rows.p: Persistent memory: signed provenance at write time plus random ablation and majority aggregation at query time
rows.a: Partly: persistent agent memory, but measures answers or verdicts
rows.i: Already adapted to agent memory; action flows still need action-level aggregation

title.en: All 810 records: question, tool answer, final record and labels
title.zh: 全部 810 条记录：问题、工具回答、最终记录与标签

p.en: Research opportunities increasingly lie in the combined conditions and interfaces of existing protection. Memory consolidation and cross-agent delegation raise the question of whether permission binding persists; the retrieval-to-writing experiment shows that, in the tested flow, TrustRAG's protection carried over to the final record, while its operating burden and the scope of authorisation need separate tests. Condition analysis turns broad research gaps into questions that experiments can answer.
p.zh: 研究机会逐步落在已有保护的组合条件与接口上。记忆整合和跨 Agent 委托提出了权限绑定能否持续的问题；检索到写入的实验表明，在所测流程中，TrustRAG 的保护延续到了最终记录，但其运行负担与授权适用范围需要分别检验。条件分析把宽泛的研究空白转化为能够被实验回答的问题。
